draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

I know inbox pileups happen, so I'll keep this short. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so getting one project up is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'll walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything else as we go.

Best,
Priya
